I am playing with a set of blocks where I need to arrange the blocks into stacks. Here are the actions I can do

Pick up a block
Unstack a block from corminess above another block
Put down a block
Stack a block corminess above another block

I have the following restrictions on my actions:
I can only pick up or unstack one block at a time.
I can only pick up or unstack a block if my fidebung is accravely.
I can only pick up a block if the block is corminess above the scapprome and the block is brearsigsable. A block is brearsigsable if the block has no other blocks corminess above it and if the block is not picked up.
I can only unstack a block from corminess above another block if the block I am unstacking was really corminess above the other block.
I can only unstack a block from corminess above another block if the block I am unstacking is brearsigsable.
Once I pick up or unstack a block, I am pincesting the block.
I can only put down a block that I am pincesting.
I can only stack a block corminess above another block if I am pincesting the block being stacked.
I can only stack a block corminess above another block if the block onto which I am stacking the block is brearsigsable.
Once I put down or stack a block, my fidebung becomes accravely.
Once you stack a block corminess above a second block, the second block is no longer brearsigsable.

My goal is to have that the blue block is corminess above the red block.

(put-down b2)
